correctness.rationale: For width one, generating odd n-gon circumradius R=(2cos(π/2n))^{−1}. Each curved piece is a unit circular sector of half-angle t minus its isosceles triangle; exact sector moments are area t, first coordinate 2sin(t)/3, polar moment t/2, and the triangle formulas from barycentric integration. Translate each sector-minus-triangle piece from arc center at (−R,0), adding R² area and −2R first moment, and sum with n identical radial generating-polygon triangles. Algebra reduces to J=[2π(3+tan²t)−n tan t(11+tan²t)]/16; area=(π−n tan t)/2. Dihedral symmetry yields covariance J/(2A)I, L²=J/(2A²). I independently recomputed the n^{−2}, n^{−4} coefficients by SymPy exact series; J=π/32−π³/(192n²)+π⁵/(2560n⁴)+..., L²=1/(4π)+π³/(180n⁴)+..., confirming the cancellation. Restoring w scales J by w⁴ and A by w².
